mechanism.claim: On a high-variation completed BTC day, unusually strong five-minute open-interest changes that lead the next five-minute price move in the completed-day direction identify informed leveraged sponsorship; that direction should relay for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed prior-day BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVOILSR uses a fixed daily one-bar lead correlation between OI increments and later price returns. Prior OI candidates used endpoint change, purge, expansion, divergence, gross churn/cancellation, contemporaneous inventory work, or round-trip episodes.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed-day BTC realized-variation causal rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one OI-lead-conditioned 00:05 UTC daily clock is absent from Gross9

features.price_path: 288 exact coherent BTCUSDT perpetual five-minute bars aggregated from 1m
features.oi_path: 289 exact positive BTCUSDT period=5m observations from D-24h-5m through D-5m; no imputation
features.lead_pairs: 287 pairs: d_i=log(OI_i/OI_(i-1)) ending at t and r_next=log(close/open) of the five-minute bar starting t+5m; every paired value is completed by D
features.lead_correlation: Pearson correlation(d_i,r_next), requiring nonzero finite variance in both vectors
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum of all 288 squared five-minute log(close/open) returns)
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 270 earlier source-valid days, minimum 180; current excluded
features.eligibility: directional-lead-score rank>=0.75 and realized-variation rank>=0.65; completed-day return strict nonzero
features.availability: D 00:00 UTC after both completed paths

clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT perpetual D 00:05 UTC open
clock.reservation: daily opportunities are nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol_rv20: only frozen OI is an input; exact funding after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source grid, lag, rank, history, threshold, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
